The '''purge trooper''' was an early design-result of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark Trooper]] [[Dark Trooper Project|Project]] meant to be used against [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. Parts of the droid's model would later be used to create the [[Phase III Dark Trooper|Phase III dark trooper]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Purge_trooper.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Purge trooper in action]]
Large in stature, purge troopers stood nearly three meters tall,<ref name="JOTS" /> much taller than most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="TFU" /> Extremely powerful<ref name="JOTS" /> and designed to combat [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users, their primary offensive weapon was a deadly<ref name="TFU" /> superheated energy blade that extended from their<ref name="JOTS" /> left<ref name="TFU" /> wrist,<ref name="JOTS" /> along with a red energy shield to block attacks.<ref name="TFU" /> The droids' [[Duranium/Legends|duranium]] armor chassis was enhanced with fibers of<ref name="JOTS" /> refined [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], an ore which reduced the damage dealt by [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] attacks.<ref name="TFU" />

Purge troopers also boasted a massive,<ref name="JOTS" /> high-powered, short-ranged<ref name="TFU" /> rocket launcher, providing them with a means of ranged attack, as well as magnetic tractor boots which made them resistant against being [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Grip|gripped]] or [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|pushed]] with the Force-based telekinesis. The missile launcher was present on their right shoulder. They could also deploy a red energy shield in combat.

The one weakness these droids had in terms of Force-based abilities was [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], which was an exploitable vulnerability.

==History==
[[File:TrianiiRangerSniper-GaW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] [[Trianii Rangers|Ranger]] targets a Purge trooper]]
Originally conceived by a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] engineer trying to devise a more effective means to fight [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]], the plans for his design were retrieved by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] after a raid on his facility killed him. The purge trooper was finalized by an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] research and development team who commissioned their creation<ref name="GAW" /> as part of the [[Dark Trooper Project]], an Imperial initiative to create various advanced [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="TFU" /> These troopers were deployed in limited numbers to hunt down the remaining Jedi after the Clone Wars.<ref name="JOTS" />

Purge Troopers attacked Lord Vader's secret apprentice, Starkiller, on several occasions, including guarding the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when Starkiller infiltrated for his [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|Trial of the Spirit]].<ref name="TFU" />

In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], an advanced purge trooper was present aboard a [[Golan space defense platform]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. During the [[Battle of Byss]], a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents boarded the platform and were attacked by the purge trooper, although they were able to defeat it.<ref name="JOTS" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
In the year [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] of an alternate timeline, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] kept a small number of old and reprogrammed purge troopers in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], Darth Vader's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and [[Sith assassin/Legends|personal assassin]], sought an audience with the Hutt criminal, Jabba ordered his henchmen to kill the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]]. As Starkiller navigated his way out of the palace, he was confronted by two purge troopers, both of which he destroyed before proceeding to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="TFU DLC">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' DLC</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
